top_news.title: Mexico Says Airlines Can Add US Routes From Mexico City Airports
top_news.summary: Mexican airlines can expand service to US cities after Washington lifted restrictions that blocked new routes from Mexico City’s two biggest airports.

top_news.title: Chip Stocks Post Longest Losing Streak Since 2008: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Another burst of selling in technology shares drove the Nasdaq 100 to its worst week since the April 2025 tariff turmoil as investors questioned the outlook for the artificial-intelligence trade.

top_news.title: Gold Steady as Rate-Hike Bets Ease, Oil Pushes Yields Higher
top_news.summary: Gold was little changed as traders weighed easing bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike against a surge in oil prices that pushed Treasury yields higher.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Suffers Worst Week Since June as AI Fears Hit Chipmakers
top_news.summary: The S&P 500 Index dropped on Friday to cap its biggest weekly loss since June, as a spike in crude prices renewed inflation fears while worries about the viability of the artificial intelligence trade pressured chipmakers.

top_news.title: Wall Street Anxiety Spreads as AI Rout Meets $110 Oil Shock
top_news.summary: Wall Street has spent the year betting on staggering AI growth while worrying about stubborn inflation. This week, investors got a fresh taste of both risks: a deepening rout in the AI complex that reached into its debt financing, and oil at $110 a barrel threatening to make inflation harder to contain.

top_news.title: Compass Sues California Home Listing Service Over Rules
top_news.summary: Compass Inc., the top US broker for residential properties, sued California’s largest real estate listing service in the latest escalation of a broader legal fight over timely access to information about homes for sale.

top_news.title: Coreweave Slides 25% for the Week as AI Credit Concerns Grow | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Kristine Aquino, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Peru Indigenous Group Bids for Part of China-Owned Mine
top_news.summary: An Indigenous community in Peru is proposing to buy part of a copper concession from MMG Ltd. and turn thousands of artisanal miners operating there into formal suppliers to the Chinese-owned company.

top_news.title: US Bonds Fall as Treasury Is Silent on Long End, Oil Climbs
top_news.summary: Treasuries declined as predictions fell flat that US government officials would directly nod at the possibility of reducing its sales of long-term debt and as oil prices rose.

top_news.title: American Dream Running Past Us: Freedman
top_news.summary:
Bess Freedman, Brown Harris Stevens CEO, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the dynamic between mortgage rates and US housing supply.
